ideas.title: The Impact of the Head Start Overhaul on Vulnerable Young Children
ideas.description: Investigate the potential consequences of the Trump administration's plan to overhaul the Head Start program.
questions: What are the potential consequences of the overhaul?
Who will be most affected by the changes?
ideas.insight: The proposed changes to the Head Start program could have far-reaching consequences for thousands of children. This story could investigate the potential motivations behind the overhaul and the potential beneficiaries of the changes.
